position.en: A period of leave granted in January 1991 precedes the first murder of the series; the question of how sentence enforcement articulates with reoffending is raised by press retrospectives.

agreement.fr: Les trois lectures s'accordent sur un point : les éléments matériels existaient avant l'identification de 1998.
